webCandidates.description: Privacy-aware, packable desktop companions for DeepSeek Harness
Find wasted GitHub Actions runner time and propose small, reviewable local patches.
DSH 主页工作区/会话右键与双击增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口等（DSH 0.2.x 适配版）
DSH Web UI 认证网关：登录保护全部 HTTP/WS 接口；用户管理、邀请码注册、TOTP 两步验证与通行密钥（Passkey/WebAuthn）登录。
Approval consultation panel for DeepSeek Harness: while a tool call waits for approval, ask the executor AI and the auto-review AI independently, in two isolated channels with prompt-cache reuse.
每日工作日志：聚合 Git 提交与本地 agent 对话（deepseek/claude/codex），按自定义模板生成日报/周报/月报；agent 工具按需注入，默认只挂一个 daily_log 派发器。
dsh 记忆与进化插件：跨会话记住你的偏好与项目习惯（全局 / 项目双作用域），自动注入、自动整理，设置面板一级「记忆」分区可视化管理。
dsh 便签插件：纸卡墙便签板 + Markdown 编辑器，便签能变任务——拖进泳道、交给 AI 在指定工作区执行、按日程定时跑；支持 WebDAV 备份与 agent 工具读写。
计费显示：从既有会话日志聚合真实 token 用量，按事件时刻价格写时锁定费用；侧栏 / 输入框下方入口 + 点击弹层 + 设置页用量视图。
Translate an agent's English execution narration into Simplified Chinese in place, reusing the official translator service; final answers, tool records and reasoning stay untouched.

Settings page (设置 → 会话压缩) for a session auto-compaction plugin that is friendly to local models: the trigger point is configurable, compaction does not make the local engine re-read the whole history, and the model writes a structured handoff summary from the prefix that is already cached.
常驻悬浮在 DSH 里的本地脚本日志面板：逐字显示 bat/cmd 输出、可自己运行与停止脚本，也能接收 BatRunner 启动器转发的日志。

Persistent bar above the conversation showing the session's first prompt, with copy, a panel of every prompt sent (click a row to jump to it), and ten switchable looks (four light) · 会话首条提问常驻条：复制 + 全部提问面板（点一行跳到那条）+ 十套可切换外观（含四套亮色）

Cyber Egg (赛博鸡蛋查询): one DeepSeek Harness panel that reads the credit balance and daily check-in status every freebie platform already stores on your machine. Read-only query plus an explicit manual check-in button — no login UI, no stored tokens.
《狼与香辛料》赫萝主题：浅色「麦秋晨光」与深色「星夜麦田」两套暖色皮肤，附带开场动画、动态档案卡、日志标签分类、右栏待机动画与可拖动探头。
One-click start for a whole dev stack: discover projects and their run commands, orchestrate a backend plus any number of frontends, and follow every log from the right sidebar.
One image behind the whole DSH shell, with a bundled default picture, a live control panel, presets, upload and a SSRF-guarded URL import.

DeepSeek Harness 插件：为第三方模型提供商的模型自动匹配模型名称并补齐推理档位（reasoning effort），使思考强度选择器在官方模型选择器中可用；并在设置页提供「模型能力」页，可编辑每个已添加模型的上下文窗口/输出上限/图片多模态。适配 DSH 0.2.0（settings/document-updated、configForms）。Third-party DSH plugin that matches model ids against a built-in knowledge table, declares per-model reasoning tiers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, and adds a settings page for per-model context window, output cap and image modality. Built against DSH 0.2.0; also runs on 0.1.5 hosts.
A settings-page switch that turns a local HTTP proxy on for the git, npm and pip commands DSH runs.
Windows 桌面控制插件：让 AI 看屏幕、点按钮、打字。不抢你的鼠标键盘、不改你的窗口状态，你随时可以在侧边栏「指挥台」打字打断它；每步都会回头核对屏幕，做不到就说做不到。零外部运行时。
dsh 的六层本地记忆：每轮收进 L1，满了分流成摘要与原文档，长期层注入上下文，并用记忆替代对话历史；按会话工作模式、人格槽位、记忆星图与热改配置。

台账记忆（Ledger Memory）—— DSH 的项目级记忆：同一项目共用一份工程进度记忆，换对话换模型近乎零交接成本；超长对话仍守住准确性、可回溯、延续性、主动回查。活跃台账自动注入，决策、目标树与经验教训卡片化，回合流水和活动日志（L0–L4）只追加；压缩前保存逐字胶囊，压缩后恢复记忆与回查指针，支持跨会话交接、持久项目锁定及扩展记忆（6 种模式）。项目台账看板提供六类核心记忆搜索、逐条字段编辑、协议格式预览与冲突保护；原则只读，流水独立追加。V3 记忆目录隔离，读写检查路径边界，编辑器提供备份与审计线索。

DSH 侧边栏文件活动插件：按 LRU 记录文件读取/新增/修改事件（最近访问），按绝对路径树形统计（文件统计），点击文件浮窗预览（代码高亮/Markdown/图片/PDF）。DSH web plugin: file activity tracker — LRU recent-access list plus per-file read/create/modify counts in a folder tree, with floating preview.

DSH 对话渲染插件（合并原 dsh-think-zh-expand + dsh-mermaid-render）：对话里的围栏块**全部由插件自己的渲染器产出**（不再调用官方 MarkdownText / CodeBlock）—— text 家族与「确证无语言且内容确实是 markdown 文档」的块按 markdown 渲染，其余（含无语言但内容是代码 / 日志的块、识别失败）渲染为「真实语言名 banner + 复制 + 自动换行 + highlight.js 高亮」的代码块（语言位留空不编造），mermaid/mmd 渲染为图表卡片；另有上下文注入块渲染、整段复制、统一 MarkdownView 导出、非标准表格容错、思考块默认展开（DOM 派发官方点击，外观零改动）。解析层 marked 与高亮层 highlight.js 走 assets 懒加载，不进 client bundle。DSH web plugin: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin's own renderer (marked + highlight.js loaded lazily from assets), never by the host MarkdownText / CodeBlock; untagged fences are routed by content (markdown doc vs code) and get an inferred language (content heuristics, then the project main language from build marker files) shown with an inferred badge, mermaid fences become diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy, a MarkdownView export, table tolerance and default-expanded thinking rows.

DSH 上下文透镜 + 成本治理插件：token 用量可视化（每次请求的上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率）+ 每轮/每会话预算控制（超限提醒/拦截）。DSH web plugin: context lens (token usage visualization, KV cache hit rate) + cost governance (per-turn / per-session budget with warn/deny).
DSH 插件治理守护：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动后热挂载——成功转正、失败自动禁用、连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板。DSH web plugin: staged plugin loading with auto-disable on failure, freeze, safe mode and a sidebar panel.
DSH 记忆插件：全局/项目两级记忆持久化，会话开始时注入系统提示词，设置页可视化面板（新增/修改/删除需用户确认），memory_query 只读查询工具。DSH web plugin: global/project memory with system-prompt injection, settings panel and a read-only query tool.
DSH 通知提醒插件：会话结束/agent 询问/等待审批时弹浏览器通知+提示音，点击跳转会话，支持远程 webhook 触发。DSH web plugin: browser notification + beep on session end / ask / approval, click-to-focus, remote trigger hook.

DSH 远程控制插件：ask/approval/end 事件下发到外部通道（手机/IM webhook），远程回答 ask、批准 approval、查询状态、继续会话；适配器接口可扩展微信/QQ/飞书机器人。DSH web plugin: push ask/approval/end events to external channels, remote answer + approve with token auth and audited commands.

Multi-level fail-closed authorization (global switch → per-connector permission mode → per-tool grants → live server-annotation evidence), mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args loudly instead of silently dropping them, honest probe status with failure codes, credential redaction on every output boundary, and an agent bridge tool whose review-all default refuses rather than fakes approval. Learnings distilled from dsh-mcp-connector, dsh-mcp-panel and openhanako's core/mcp.

Media evidence lens + provider router for DeepSeek Harness: media_read_video / media_read_audio / media_read_image turn local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / regions) via host-registered multimodal models first, configured OpenAI-compatible endpoints second, and local ffmpeg/CLI fallbacks last. Every fallback is recorded in meta.attempts — a fallback is never silent.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks as a structured, sortable, filterable table in the right sidebar — with sheet tabs and a circuit breaker (rows/cols/cells plus the two zip-container gates) so no input can freeze the browser.
dsh-paste-dock — DeepSeek Harness 插件:大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留最小徽标。

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move, targeting the DSH 0.2.0 line (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render .pptx decks as a readable structured view in the right sidebar — slide list (in deck order, not filename order), text with bullet levels, speaker notes, inline pictures — with a circuit breaker so no deck can freeze the tab. Reading view, not a slide reproduction.

Preset doctor for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects broken agent presets (legacy format, renamed packages, stale config keys) and mechanically repairs them to the current 0.1.7+ syntax, with backup, atomic writes and idempotence. Also validates preset prompt injections (dsh-preset-studio `注入/*.md`) exactly the way the injector reads them.
L0~L3 分层蒸馏记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：自动捕获对话（L0）、抽取原子记忆（L1）、整合场景块（L2）、蒸馏核心画像/团队方法论（L3），并在模型步骤前自动召回注入。移植自 MemoryCore (TencentDB Agent Memory) 的管线设计。
DSH Web 插件：会话原文投影同步器（DRS）——只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions 会话日志，解码后投影进自有 SQLite（segments/replaces/FTS5），经 /api/dsh-reference-session-collector 提供 surface 标记、召回对账与内容检索面。绝不写会话文件。
DSH 会话检索插件：标题 / 内容双模式 FTS5 检索（内容检索硬依赖 dsh-reference-session-collector 投影库，按会话聚合展示标题与命中片段并支持命中定位），自带独立索引（增量同步、非破坏性整理、深度同步自愈、快照导入导出）。入口双形态：宿主 ≥0.1.7 走「插件页式」主栏整页，<0.1.7 走侧栏弹窗。
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。

Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28×28 square toggle collapses them to that single header line and expands them back. The fold state persists per window, kept-visible rows are picked from the live sidebar, and the managed rows' icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right.
DSH host plugin: thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for dsh — auto-adjust per tool round, with optional manual lock and per-tool timing telemetry.
One plugin for a calmer DeepSeek Harness: reading view + message rail + smart history loading, for Harness 0.1.0-0.2.1 (all rc).

Union web search for DeepSeek Harness (renamed from dsh-free-search): free keyless engines + many professional paid search APIs — 28 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso with key; OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok model built-in search, explicit-only) + auto smart routing + global engine enable/disable & fallback priority + multi mode (parallel top-3 merge) + multi_search cross-source tool + failure-aware fallback + block system built-in search toggle + experimental free advance_fetch (no API key, no billing; host-twin GitHub-Flavored Markdown conversion + CSS selector/fields structured extraction) + time filtering + platform search + web_fetch, with web settings UI.
See commits and uncommitted changes from every Git repository in a DSH workspace, together in one timeline.
Local knowledge base for dsh web: composer-managed directory/file connections, per-question retrieval via the knowledge_base tool

Cross-session recall for dsh web: '@' mentions and a composer picker link previous sessions as reference chips; the host snapshots them in as recall context right before the question, recorded read-only in a session-header chain badge
多 Agent 团队的静态成员档案定义与校验层：档案库在面板里看得见、改得动，团队成员的人设、模型与工具边界固化成可校验、可版本化的文件，并在 dsh-agent-teams 创建成员时把档案桥接给运行时。

When the threshold fires (or /force-compact queues while busy), the latest `retainLatestTokens` of the conversation's surface tokens are KEPT VERBATIM and everything before that cutoff is COMPACTED INTO A SINGLE SUMMARY NODE in one LLM call (original span entries become shadowed/skipped). Also compacts at each turn/end and at each session/flush durability checkpoint. Host half is a pure listener; a web client half registers a settings.section (强制压缩 / Force Compact) that reads and writes the same settings namespace.

DSH Cordis plugin: announces the moment an agent finishes (turns idle) by pushing a 'done' signal from the Host half into the falling-ts-web-ding settings namespace, which the browser client half mirrors live and answers with a synthesized 'ding' tone via the Web Audio API. The tone is played ENTIRELY by front-end JS in the browser — the Host/node backend never emits audio and no Windows/system notification is used.

webCandidates.description: VS Code (from a code-server release) inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab driven by the plugin's own launcher over the in-process VS Code server (lib/launcher.mjs), plus an editor bridge (assets/extensions/dshcs-editor-bridge) that gives the agent what only the editor knows (unsaved buffers, language-server diagnostics, the active selection) and lets editor gestures drive the session. The bridge is completely read-only: all four of its routes (/health, /sync, /old, /event) are reads. Asking DSH from the editor opens a floating dialog inside the DSH page (draggable, resizable, bottom-right): the plugin's client half sends the question as user input (POST /api/code-server/ask/send) and renders that session's new content with DSH's own Markdown renderer - the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives instance the UI uses, required from the page's module table, so typography, highlighting and math match the interface and a renderer version mismatch is impossible. Thinking appears as collapsed rows and approval requests (writing outside the workspace / running commands) can be answered in place: whole-plugin write route POST /api/code-server/ask/approve, constrained to pending in-process requests and the outcomes allowed-once/rejected; dialog-first for 5 minutes, handed back to the official card the moment the dialog closes, never auto-approved. There is no build step anywhere: lib/client.js (client half including the dialog panel) and the extension are committed hand-written source, devDependencies holds a single test-only entry, and the published package carries no frontend bundle. Also: the tab claims DSH file addresses (dsh-resource://file/**) by file type (setting claimExtensions), so produced-file chips, delivered-file previews and inline prose mentions open in the workbench; the IDE is a resident surface moved with Element.moveBefore instead of being remounted, so switching sidebar tabs does not reload it; opening the tab switches the right sidebar to fullscreen by default (setting fullscreenOnOpen); a workspace switch re-navigates the workbench with the new ?folder= without restarting the IDE process. Requires a DSH with the right-sidebar services (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight, >= 0.1.5-alpha.1); older DSH versions only get an upgrade notice on the settings page. Two serving modes: loopback port (default) or same-origin mount on DSH's own webServer (/code-server, protected by ctx.connection.requestRejection). The diff the bridge opens always has the real pre-write text on the left, taken from result.value.before in tools/post-execute into a bounded snapshot cache and fetched by opaque key over the read-only GET /old, so files that are not open in the editor work too. No code-server Node layer, no argon2, no C++ toolchain.

DSH 插件：dsh-better-sidebar 原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab——移植 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0，host 直跑 git 命令 + 同源静态服务，经 scope.repoRoot/scope.cwd 自动绑定会话工作区，点文件 diff 直接打开内置 DiffTab；前置依赖 dsh-better-sidebar。
Get记忆插件：对话开始时自动拉取GitHub指定仓库的内容并注入上下文；对话结束时提取值得长期记住的新信息写回并提交；左栏快捷面板实时查看状态，设置界面进行详细配置
Custom reusable Subagent Definitions with a Settings page and one delegate_agent tool for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness prompt-refinement plugin: rewrite a rough request into a clear, professional prompt, with one-click undo and a configurable model
DSH 左侧边栏「Skill 管理」：按调用频次与上下文占用查看全局 / 项目级 skill，支持可逆归档与还原。
Visual git commit/branch graph as a right-sidebar tab in DSH Desktop
Foxy — a DSH agent preset with a foxy3 persona and an extension-contract layer for memory, transports and capabilities.
Foxy 的 B 站子插件：自己刷视频、读字幕、决定要不要评论/记住，并通过 foxy3 人设与 memory 说话。
Memory subplugin for dsh-foxy: local JSONL archive plus optional cross-platform Foxy Memory API, recall and search.
DeepClear UI — a quiet dot-matrix theme for reading, coding and working in dsh.
DSH plugin ecosystem operations layer: dependency drift radar, failure brake, and token/latency attribution
Web-switchable agent loop engine selection for the DeepSeek Harness - out-of-tree plugin (Claude Code / Codex / Pi / Kimi Code drivers) maintained by @kuun993, zero main-repo changes
Seven Gruvbox themes for DeepSeek Harness, with a preview picker, persisted selection, and system light/dark following.
Decode: code-repository Q&A for DeepSeek Harness, with cw-uml interactive diagrams, code evidence per paragraph and the files it used. No setup.

Animated whale particle background for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI: the WHALE-silhouette particle field with a decaying pointer-wake field plus the official dot-grid layer, registered into the frame-wide shell.overlay seat.
DSH SuperAdvisor: on-demand second opinions with manual, model-tag, independent AI or approve-all policies
Strict workflow document viewer plugin for DeepSeek Harness

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) panel for writing-anything workspaces (.writing-anything/): read-only overview dashboard, unit tree, artifact semantic-card and source-highlight views, sources list, plus a same-origin proxy that embeds the wa-cli reading view for unit review.
把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里的主语人称「我/你/I/me」渲染成 DeepSeek 蓝鲸图标：字体层零 DOM 改动、复制保留原字、深色模式白肚子固定。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: the main conversation dispatches work into real thread sessions and gets short summaries back.
删掉不喜欢的 AI 回复，或删掉已发送的错误提示词 —— 每条消息可撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后。DSH 插件：写 append-only 墓碑，模型上下文与界面同步移除。Per-message recall & delete for DeepSeek Harness sessions.

一个插件、三种角色：主服务端把 DeepSeek Harness 变成手机能安全访问的 PWA（移动端界面、配对码网关、Web Push），并把选定会话共享给已配对的桌面端；子客户端在另一台 DSH 桌面端的侧边栏里远程使用这些会话；节点端凭一条 zr-net:// 邀请链接加入自建虚拟网络，多台电脑自动双向发现并互通会话。One DSH plugin, three roles: the host turns DeepSeek Harness into a phone-reachable PWA (mobile UI, pairing-code gateway behind your own reverse proxy, Web Push) and shares chosen sessions to paired desktops; the client uses those sessions remotely from another DSH desktop app's sidebar; the peer joins a self-hosted virtual network via one zr-net:// invite link, and machines in the network discover each other's shared sessions automatically.
ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, charts, tables, layers and local controls.
Adds pinned and recent session groups at the top of the workspace list in the DSH sidebar. Rows open the host session menu, and each group header has a settings popup.

pstack for DeepSeek Harness: rigorous agent workflows ported from cursor/plugins.

针对单个会话的定时上下文截断插件：可配置多少小时无输入之后，丢弃较早的对话（不生成摘要），避免同一个长期会话把上一个任务带进下一个。 / Per-session idle-time context truncation for DSH Web: after a configurable number of idle hours the older conversation is dropped (no summary), so one long-lived session (e.g. an IM bridge) cannot leak one task into the next.
统计本机全部 DSH 会话的历史 token 总消耗，按 message.id 去重，支持按天/模型/Provider/项目分组。Global token-usage totals across all DSH conversations.
按时间段挑选 DSH 会话与项目 git 提交，参考你自己以前写的报告样例，生成日报/周报/月报（Markdown）。Pick DSH sessions and git commits for a window, then write a daily/weekly/monthly report in your own house style.

Cross-session reference (mention) for DeepSeek Harness: paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session — including one in another workspace — and the host resolves and injects the referenced session snapshot via the native session-reference pipeline. Includes a composer button that copies the current session's mention.
Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH chat composer — a standalone installable DSH plugin (ported from the Obsidian Animated Cursor plugin)
Let the model read the current session's sidebar on demand: the active tab, official right-sidebar tabs, terminal screens and browser page text.
填写任一可用搜索来源的 API Key，开启插件即可接管网页搜索；支持共享配置、补充来源静默回退和即时恢复官方搜索。

Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend, with the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand. · 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

Mobile UI fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web profile: a restart row, a scrollable question region, a throttled reaction to streaming message storms, a guarded subagent-catalog refresh, click-to-open lineage chips, a narrow-header collector sheet, a throttled session-list render under background streaming load, and a hover-kept connection card with manual refresh. Binds the host's stable data-* contracts and local class names, never build hashes, so a rebuild cannot silently disable it.

Per-command sandbox allow-list for the DSH bash tool, managed from Settings and the Plugins page: allow-listed CLIs run with configurable writable roots (workspace stays writable on macOS/Linux) instead of prompting for danger-full-access; write-neutral pipes such as `2>&1 | tail -N` still match, and a narrow-root rule can accept any command shape.
给 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）加 QQ 机器人通道：OneBot 11 协议，兼容 NapCat。在 dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4 基础上分叉，加了消息合并、分条发送、群聊工具闸、静默作息、试运行 dryRun、每日收发统计与可视化设置页。
DeepSeek Harness 壁纸插件：图片/视频背景（GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM），格式自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调跟随，填充方式可调，侧栏/顶栏等组件透明度可控。纯客户端实现。
DSH plugin: branch visibility and git worktree isolation for Web UI sessions
dsh local plugin: persist per-request model token usage (live hook + first-run history backfill + web settings stats page)
Configurable, unobtrusive Agent lifecycle sound cues for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), synthesized with Web Audio.
A deterministic piano performance plugin for DSH: shared musical timeline, piano audio engine, visual engine, and DSH-compatible host/browser boundary.
Fluid streaming rendering and silky scrolling for DeepSeek Harness replies, including Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool results.
Search, pin, combine and inject skills and prompts into the current conversation from the DSH right sidebar.
Capture the literal HTTP request/response of every LLM provider call (by patching globalThis.fetch) and show them in a Wire Trace session tab
Push a WeCom (企业微信) group-robot notification the instant DSH needs a human: permission approval, a question, a finished task, a blocked goal, or an error
A cockatiel appearance for the dsh-workpet capability in DeepSeek Harness.

探奇 (Tanqi) for the dsh web GUI: AI-generated curiosity items with layered deep-dives. A sidebar entry opens the panel — 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item can be unfolded into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, every layer, every similar point) in browser localStorage. The model channel reuses the host's own LLM (ctx.llm, zero config); when the host has no usable model, the user can paste a DeepSeek API key which is stored locally in the browser. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules symlink, no dsh source changes.

DeepSeek Harness web plugin: adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar questions on a conversation fork and default-browser link opening. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark for jumping back, the menu opens on selection or from the right-click menu, and the translation model can be picked separately.
CAD visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cad_view / cad_info tools with an embedded 3D (STL/OBJ/STEP/IGES) and 2D (DXF/SVG) viewer card in the Web UI

DeepSeek Harness enhancements: Markdown theme for every renderer, select-text annotations with pins, a file right-click menu, a narrower sidebar, and startup defaults (maximized window, narrowest sidebar, colourful running marker). 中文：DSH 增强插件——Markdown 主题、划词批注、文件右键菜单、侧栏宽度、启动默认状态。
Switch between Bottom, Right, and Automatic Composer layouts, with responsive sizing and space-aware controls.
API token usage and estimated cost reports for DeepSeek Harness, with per-route pricing, session totals and CNY/USD display.

Codex-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness. An independent reviewer decides allow/deny, fail-closed, with a rationale for every decision. Engine: an LLM route, or TypeSafe's Jev (`reviewer.engine`). · DSH 插件：独立复核器裁决，引擎可选 LLM 路由或 Jev。

项目记忆（Project Memory）：本地优先的项目记忆插件。每个项目一份 .dsh-memory.json（按 cwd 隔离），提供 memory_read/recall/write/update/delete 五工具、/memory 命令、设置页记忆管理 UI（编辑/删除/拖动排序/一键保存排序/状态过滤/搜索/多项目切换），全部遵循'随核心快速适配'（适配器+探测-退化-上报）与'万物皆插件'（可独立挂载/停用）。【单线 0.1.3】2026-09-11 起取消双线：只面向 DSH 最新核心（0.1.5-rc.1 及更新，桌面端 2.0.7+/2.0.9），不再为旧核做适配；含读取保序修复与「保存排序」二次确认/回读校验。同属 0.1.x 系列——**只有出现较大优化或新功能时才升 0.2.0**（本版暂不发布）。

Chat-first development flow tracker for DeepSeek Harness: scan, clarify, plan, review, test and report repository-aware changes.

Union workspaces for the dsh web GUI: merge multiple directories into one session (primary + members), persist them under ~/.dsh/union-workspaces.json, apply a permission preset per union, browse member files in a right-side panel, and manage everything from a settings section and the /uw command. Hot-pluggable — mounted via ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules link, no dsh source changes.

Six-Line Divination (liuyao) for DeepSeek Harness — one-click casting, eight-palace najia chart, AI interpretation, chart card and case archive. 六爻起卦 · AI 解卦：一键起卦、纳甲装卦、按所问事项断卦。

DSH plugin: usage and credit balance monitor — auto-query provider balances from configured API keys.

DSH 桌面守望提醒：模型需要你操作（审批 / 方案确认 / 提问）或后台回复完成时，弹出系统通知与提示音，点击通知直接跳转到对应会话。另含出错 / 中断 / 用量上限提醒、安静时段、子代理过滤、当轮统计（token / 缓存命中率 / TPS）、工作流进展、SSE 桥与 Webhook（企微 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）、远程触发，以及「设置 → 消息通知」图形设置页。 Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a system toast, a per-kind chime and a title marker when the agent needs your input or a reply finishes in the background — click the notification to jump straight to that session. ExHentai.org-inspired dark gallery skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: gallery chrome, optional native sidebar, mutually exclusive skin/native composer, per-option [...] panels, and reversible settings.
DeepSeek Harness 开发者工具箱插件:侧边栏入口 + 底部终端面板,可开始/终止进程、手工输入命令,并浏览 AI 输出结果。
QQ 风格皮肤插件 for DeepSeek Harness: overlays a Tencent QQ messenger look on the Web client through the official theme token layer (ctx.theme.overrideTokens).
A donkey treadmill background for the DSH Web UI: a top-down donkey pulls the millstone at a pace driven by the model's live token throughput.

webCandidates.description: AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness: 43 native research tools, natural-language /ai4s-* commands, papers, scholars, patents, full text, references and scientific figures. Powered by ai4scholar.net.
DSH 自动化任务监视器：在会话视图里加一个「自动化」标签页，只读汇总「谁在自动跑、上次跑没跑、下次什么时候跑、花多少 token」。
鹈鹕环海骑行：右下角 SVG 动画 + 全局消息状态提示（静态双端插件）
A session workspace for DeepSeek Harness, modeled on the Claude app — forked sessions in one tree, split view, and a right rail per session.
Cron scheduler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: schedule agent tasks via natural language or a sidebar UI, with fixed/new session strategies, run history, manual trigger, and live sync.

Autonomic heartbeat for DeepSeek Harness: silent pulses diff the session's todos / team board / goal, then speaks only on a signal (report / ask / escalate) with dedupe, quiet hours and a daily budget; carries a heart mark in the settings sidebar.

Long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: persistent cross-session markdown memory with a soul/persona file, auto-injected at every session start, plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows and portable migration tooling.
DSH 社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题 + 热门插件 TOP10，悬浮可拖动、置顶、点击居中展开、列表直达内容页。
长周期自主执行插件：一个目标拆成可并行的子任务，交付一份合并报告，重启后仍可继续。

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: shows the CNY cost of every completed turn under the turn, from per-model cache-hit / cache-miss / cache-write / output rates, with weekly peak-valley multipliers and limited-time promo windows.
Chat background image, sidebar veil, composer strip, task progress bar and all-session token total for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.
A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: multiple notes, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.

Agent 空管中心 for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar panel listing every local agent session (DSH, codex, opencode, WorkBuddy, Gemini) with attention-first grouping and folded history — zero token, host-side inference.
崩坏：星穹铁道 · 流萤主题 —— 立绘壁纸背景 + 萤火绿霓虹配色 + 开屏变身动画
DeepSeek Harness 模块化模型选择器：根据模型来源（Provider 如 CodeBuddy、Qoder、DeepSeek 等）分块展示，支持分块下钻、全局搜索与推理强度调节。

JIRA open tasks panel plus a sidebar task-statistics page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.1.7-0.2.x, web and Desktop: shows the current user's open/reopened issues below the composer, and a left-sidebar entry that opens per-project statistics (summary, a version-statistics list paged 10 versions at a time, and a clickable version task list with sortable columns and your own issues first) with project switching, per-workspace project key, persistent profile bundle.
古法编程 · AI 辅助：一键把 DSH 主面板变成 VS Code 风格 IDE（Monaco 编辑器、文件树、Git、SSH、真实终端 + 右侧官方会话）；主张亲手写、每个改动心中有数，AI 是助理、你是第一责任人
DSH web plugin: bottom-right reminder when the agent is blocked waiting for a human answer
DSH 插件兼容性体检：自动探测本机 dsh 版本与能力（含实测校准），适配任意 dsh 版本；启动时检查已装插件是否冲突，在 DSH 页面上给出中文预警与一键修复（隔离/卸载/升级），并提前预警「快要不适配」的插件
DSH Web 移动端热键模式：自动检测移动端并切换发送/换行键位（发送 Ctrl+Enter / 换行 Enter），设置面板提供开关
Self-contained car-dashboard style Token gauge for DeepSeek Harness: live token speed, session/today usage, spend and cache hit rate, with four skins and two layouts.

Annotate replies and documents; edit past user messages and rerun from that point. Use ↑/↓ or Page Up/Page Down to browse user messages, or recall inputs at the composer's text boundaries; elsewhere, edit normally.
Manage a local CLIProxyAPIPlus server, YAML configuration, Qoder and Codex credentials, live quota, and runtime logs.
Shell-style input history for the DSH composer: ArrowUp recalls messages you already sent, ArrowDown walks forward, restores your draft, and a further press discards it.
Beads issue-graph panel for the DeepSeek Harness left sidebar: browse ready/open beads, read issue detail, and create, claim, or close beads through the bd CLI.
Review commits produced in the session workspace, grouped by repository, with per-file diffs.
Plug-in vision for text-only LLMs, powered by the free Antigravity CLI

The strongest free web search plugin for coding agents. Plug-in web search, X search, and page fetch for models without native web access. Free out of the box: no signup, no API key (Firecrawl keyless, 1,000 free credits/month)
DeepSeek Harness Web overlay: knockable wooden-fish sprite and per-session merit plaque
Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: capabilities, injected prompts, install scripts, and provenance, each with file:line evidence. Facts, not a safety verdict.

Permanently delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the UI (header button + sidebar row menu) or via the session_delete tool: releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions a session owns (your forked branches are never touched). The deleted session disappears from the UI and session lists immediately.
Local clean-Markdown full or selective-turn export for the current DeepSeek Harness Web conversation.
Inline per-turn token cost in CNY for DeepSeek Harness — shows each turn's estimated cost right after the usage/time indicator, with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing.

Window Controls Overlay title bar for the DSH web app: the manifest opts in, and the app's own logo row and session header become the window caption. 让 DSH Web 应用清单启用 Window Controls Overlay，把应用自身的 logo 行与会话 header 变成窗口标题栏。
Browse, install, enable, and update plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
DeepSeek Harness tools for GenBox: image generation/editing (including inpaint, upscale, cutout) and video generation through a local GenBox server.
本地优先、支持富文本编辑的 DSH Web 侧边栏工作清单插件
爆款视频复刻工作台：原片 → 角色图（审核门）→ 换人 → 质检 → 成片，外加素材库、三轨时间线与 RunningHub 任意工作流接入。

A personal proactive agent as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: cron schedules and a local inbox directory become Triggers, a deterministic gate turns them into authorized Tickets, and each Ticket runs in its own DSH Session and directory, reporting back through a panel and the file system.

webCandidates.description: Voice Studio for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel that manages GPT-SoVITS voices (training, switching, speaking) and RVC covers (voice conversion, separation, mixing) on Windows.
DSH plugin: show DeepSeek API pricing, token usage/cost and account balance inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
用 agent 干活时把安卓手机/平板投到 DSH 右侧栏并反控，刷视频、回消息不用拿手机：scrcpy 内核 + WebCodecs
Policy-only multi-source quota router for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic task profiles, ordered candidate chains, health-aware fallback, and observable decisions.
把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角滚动条、Bliss 桌面壁纸）＋ 一轮跑完时的提示音与完成弹窗。
Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider for DeepSeek Harness

DSH Host plugin: block tool calls that create temporary directories/files in the workspace root (including the 0.2.2 apply_patch tool), with a graphical settings page. Workspace root follows the session; temp dir name, deny patterns and denial text are configurable.

DSH Host plugin: monitor agent turn status, send OS notifications (Windows toasts branded with the DSH icon, click-to-focus, sound, reminders, localized copy, short session labels, privacy mode), alert pending approvals and user questions/plan reviews, auto-continue network/model-request failures, and expose a graphical settings page in the DSH Web client.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: live account balance/usage panel for every configured LLM provider (draggable floating-ball widget, configurable refresh interval and balance thresholds)
可配置峰谷自动会话门：config/offpeak.json 驱动 peak 时段 + 周末全天 off-peak + 单会话「畅跑」限时无视峰谷 + 高峰自动暂停/波谷自动恢复 + 按模型名的高峰拦截列表。
Composer toggle that shapes replies: conclusion first, inline quotes, no cross-turn references
Composer infinity toggle: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click adds an unlimited-token-budget notice to the system prompt.

Colour, size and typeface for the DeepSeek Harness UI: pick a text colour for light/dark each, a body size, and a font — built-in Kai/Xing/Li/Song/Hei families, four open-source calligraphy fonts (OFL), or import your own .ttf/.otf/.woff2. · 统一改 DSH 界面文字的颜色、字号和字体。

Local plugin installer for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page with a file picker — pick .tgz plugin packages and install them into the current profile without a terminal. 本地插件安装器：设置页里点按钮选择本地 .tgz 插件包直接安装。
Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
本地语音唤醒：常听麦克风 + DSH 内置 SenseVoice 识别；只说唤醒词，听到提示音后说内容，自动发送到会话；带可拖动 HUD 卡片。
Screenshot feedback for DeepSeek Harness — let your coding agent SEE what it builds
在对话框右侧加一个「优化」按钮，用当前模型按 prompt-optimizer 的「基础优化」模板改写草稿，结果直接写回输入框。
MCP server marketplace for DeepSeek Harness: browse a curated catalog of MCP servers and install them into the running profile with one click (powered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client).
DeepSeek Harness 多 Agent 3D 协作办公室插件：在会话页顶部标签行直接打开当前会话的 3D 办公室，观察真实主会话、子 Agent、工具活动与汇报，支持目录/会话切换和跨目录搜索。
Virtual workspace groups for the DSH web sidebar: a built-in default group, group create/rename/delete, drag-and-drop project grouping and ordering.

Balance & cost widget for the DeepSeek Harness GUI (web and desktop app): a sidebar footer card shows the DeepSeek account balance and today's costs; clicking opens a popover with a five-tier cost breakdown (last prompt with session name / today-this-session / today-this-workspace / today-all-workspaces), peak/off-peak status tag, term explanations, and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies — works on Node 24.
A precise, safe code editor inside DSH's native file tabs.
Delete unwanted conversations from the sidebar with multi-select and a 30-day recycle bin that can restore them.
Workspace-based Bash Guard policy with native inline permission controls
Feishu OAuth login for DeepSeek Harness using native session cookies
Plan ready tool-call batches to reduce model round trips in DeepSeek Harness
Cache-first compaction with optional adaptive economics for DeepSeek Harness
DeepSeek Harness profile bundle: run subagent delegations in the local CodeBuddy CLI (ACP) with a pinned model

DLT (DeepSeek Light Tool) — DSH 永久插件：每轮对话的人民币消耗、右下角账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel 直接读写工具与右栏预览、硬编码的编译/运行环境表与直接执行程序的工具、输入框旁的草图按钮（现画一张 → 图片附件或 PNG 路径），并带一个「DLT 管理器」运行期总开关；被 DET 全量接管时整体停摆。Permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-turn CNY cost, account balance, native PDF/Word/Excel read-write tools and right-sidebar previews, a hardcoded compiler/runtime environment registry, direct run/build tools, an inline sketch button (draw → image attachment or PNG path), and a runtime master switch; steps aside entirely while DET takes over.

DSH 永久插件：LVAL 工程工具（编译/运行/代码查看/程序版本快照回退）+ 对话树 VTD（会话内分支/编辑/重新生成）+ 消息小版本 + DET 管理器 + 全局插件控制（五档 + 两种安装路径）+ MDA 分层（CDM 跨对话记忆 / TCT 临时对话 / 模型合作）+ MMS 混合模型 + 网络权限 5 档 + 安全审计 + 浏览器控制（扩展）+ DLT 集成 + **ALV 辅助线视觉（栅格/标尺/辅助线、边线坐标提取、本机 OCR、切块、标注、增强）** + **ADU 按需装载（模块表 → 深查 → 装载，启动只装 5 个元工具）**。Permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin: project tooling, VTD conversation tree, message micro-versions, feature manager, global plugin control, MDA layering (CDM/TCT/model cooperation), MMS, network permission tiers, security audit, browser control via extension, DLT integration, ALV aided line vision (grids/rulers/guide lines, edge-position extraction, on-device OCR, tiling, annotation, enhancement) and ADU lazy tool loading (module table -> deep query -> mount).
Hangs a clothesline of polaroid photos under the message composer in DeepSeek Harness.

DeepSeek Harness web plugin: header balance button (left of the native Session log), dropdown with account balance, live per-session model + token usage and official-rate cost estimates; auto-hides on the settings page
必应每日壁纸作为 DeepSeek Harness 界面背景：每天自动更换，可选最近 30 天任意一天。Bing daily wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.

DSH session archive button: an icon in the official sidebar.footer.action slot (beside Settings) that opens its panel upward. First click dry-runs a scan of DSH sessions idle for more than 3 days; second click packs each into a byte-verified zip and removes the original folder. Uses the vk layout seat when dsh-vk-suite is present. Never triggered by the model.
本机文件搜索（DSH 插件）：在对话框 @ 列表里增加「搜索本机文件」入口，全机一次性搜索，结果不进文件栏/工作区索引

Multi-window long-running task management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a task is a persistent folder (7-document archive with a fact-only immutable list, numbered checklist items and milestones, plus a minimal handoff index), with lock-based concurrency, content snapshots, a 6-state machine, and a left-sidebar Tasks view.
DeepSeek 钱包（DSH 插件）：显示账户余额 · 今日累计 · 本会话消耗（悬停看 token/金额明细）· 可编辑提醒阈值与低余额/超阈值系统通知，一键打开官方充值 / API Key / 用量页，并注册 query_deepseek_balance 工具。入口注册在官方 sidebar.footer.action 槽；装了 dsh-vk-suite 时用它的常驻面板位。
记忆星图 · DeepSeek Harness 外置长期记忆：跨会话、抗压缩，零依赖（自带 48MB 语义模型，numpy 推理，不需要 torch）；三路召回（BM25 / 稠密向量 / PPR 图扩散）经 RRF 融合、情绪作调制乘子；幂律遗忘与五层沉海、突触标记与捕获；可交互的记忆星图。
DeepSeek Harness mobile pairing remote plugin: E2EE companion over a dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN / Tailscale / optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).

DeepSeek Harness coding-subscription OAuth: SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code, Claude Code. Fixes AUTH API key is invalid, INVALID_REPLAY_STATE, grok-4.6 xhigh, Kimi Bearer vs x-api-key.

Local-first usage, cost, quota, account, and forecast analytics for DeepSeek Harness Web, with coding-subscription OAuth sign-in (Grok Build, Codex, Kimi Code, Claude Code), an optional loopback API gateway, and opt-in local auth/usage monitoring
A shared right sidebar for dsh: one column beside Chat, plugins contribute tabs into the `rightbar.tab` slot instead of each floating its own fixed panel.
DeepSeek Harness Ultra Slash：独立斜杠命令分组；/steer /new /skill /docs，以及可配置的自定义 /steer 子命令
DeepSeek Harness Web UI 工作台：聊天 / 编辑器（语法高亮） / 文件与 Git、侧边栏、模型工具
A per-turn token usage strip for DeepSeek Harness: a segmented bar plus a written legend in every reply's icon row, showing this turn's uncached input / cache read / output split.
DSH 原生抖音工具与独立 DeepSeek 本地助手
Hand a standalone job to the Cursor CLI already signed in on this machine.
Capture the desktop with a frame selector and drop the crop into the DSH composer as a prompt image — the screenshot entry Doubao and QQ have, added to DeepSeek Harness itself.

Peak / off-peak rate badges and switch countdown for DeepSeek Harness — per provider, per model, in the model selector and the composer tool row. Judges each provider by its own time zone and schedule instead of DeepSeek-only hours.
课程文件 → 目录识别 · 分章知识点总结 · B 站网课推荐 · 学习报告（DeepSeek Harness bundle）
DSH web plugin: personal toolbox with per-feature toggles, task-done corner notification, and one-click dsh web restart.
Return to a DeepSeek Harness session with a trustworthy, non-intrusive recap.
在 DeepSeek Harness 任务中提醒用户理解重要事实和方案取舍。
Starts DeepSeek Harness automatically with Windows, and adds a Settings > General switch plus a dsh_autostart tool to inspect, enable or disable the startup entry.
DSH bundle adding a copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box's copy while the real disk is untouched.
Per-conversation Ralph Loop, Agent Teams, and Codex Subagent switches for DeepSeek Harness.
An unofficial community integration for Desktop Commander in DeepSeek Harness.
Named Bots and group conversations for DeepSeek Harness.

Markdown enhancements for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a low-priority composer takeover card with a CodeMirror 6 live-rendering editor (Obsidian-style), Markdown-rendered user messages, and rich-text paste conversion — built-in takeover panels keep precedence, and every surface capability-probes and degrades to the native composer (ADR-0005)
CodeGraph and CodeWalkthrough for DeepSeek Harness: source-linked Mermaid diagrams and long-form interactive explainer pages.
智能工作台 — DeepSeek Harness 原生插件：AI 助手、待办与待回复、研发任务、AI 资讯、知识空间、多 AI 对话和开发工具。
Session status notifications for the DeepSeek Harness: provider-based webhooks with a WeCom group robot, managed from the Settings panel.
DSH 浏览器插件（Browser）：以 Codex 浏览器操作为体验参考，直接使用你已登录的 Chrome 浏览器，平滑虚拟鼠标、页面读取、填表与截图。安装后点侧栏「浏览器」连接 Chrome。欢迎 Star 与参与共创。
Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：项目配置 → 11 阶段流水线 → 人工复核 → PR 说明（DSH 全局插件）

DeepSeek Harness 插件：为用户显式声明的工作区目录预置 Windows ACL 完全控制 ACE，补上沙箱授权所需的 WRITE_OWNER 前提，消除危险模式弹框。
Persistent Quick Actions for the DSH message composer

Zero-dependency molecular-biology plugin bundle for the DeepSeek Harness: sequence analysis, primer design (incl. cross-intron qPCR primers, TaqMan hydrolysis/MGB probes with ordering CSV and multiplex compatibility), in-silico PCR, cloning simulation, SnapGene .dna parsing and plasmid maps, Sanger verification, protein tools (incl. helical wheel, hydropathy and charge-pH plots), methylation-aware restriction analysis with double-digest buffer checks, qPCR analysis and plotting, multiple sequence alignment that conserves every input residue, conservation analysis, sequence logos, codon-usage analysis, phylogenetic trees with bootstrap support, Newick I/O and long-name label wrapping, CpG-island/GC-skew composition analysis, k-mer dotplots, read-level FASTQ QC, vector/adapter contamination screening, FASTQ trimming/filtering, batch file analysis with CSV export, silent restriction-site mutagenesis, family-aware CRISPR gRNA design (SpCas9/SaCas9/Cas12a/Cas13) with off-target search, an opt-in hand-off that shows a generated plot to the model as an attached image, plus a browser-side right-sidebar panel (plasmid maps, sequence logos, and a rotatable realistic 3D ball-and-stick/space-filling preview of PDB/mmCIF/SDF structures drawn in the Web GUI) and a literature/protocol/experiment record system.

Favourite any DSH conversation, copy its session id + transcript absolute path, delete one conversation permanently (guarded), batch-archive conversations idle for more than N hours, filter the sidebar down to favourites, export a conversation list as tab-separated txt, edit-resend or undo any user turn with automatic file snapshots that roll back with it, hand a long conversation over to a fresh window with a distilled brief (requirement timeline + task progress, preset inherited), diagnose/clean the sidebar 'Ungrouped' bucket (with a boot-time warning and a dry-run-first one-click fix), sweep orphan projection-cache records that no directory scan can see, and hide the bucket by default — additive slot extensions over the shipped archive feature, editing no official file. 为 DSH 对话加上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条永久删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选，并导出对话清单；另含会话管理：用户消息可编辑重发、撤销整轮，AI 改过的文件自动快照并在回滚时一并还原；再含一键新窗口继续对话：把长对话蒸馏成「要求时间线 + 任务进度」交接书，继承原对话预设，在新窗口自动发送；还有侧栏「未分组」体检：一键只读诊断 + 先试算后执行的清理，并在每次开机时告警；外加清理目录扫描看不见的投影缓存幽灵，且默认就隐藏该分组。全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方一行代码。

DSH 产物路径联动器：常驻注入「产物路径铁律」让模型输出完整绝对路径，同时把聊天正文里的文件名/路径渲染成一键可点的产物芯片——左键在右侧边栏预览（对齐官方交付卡片，绝对路径 0 次解析直通，侧栏认领不了自动退回系统默认程序），Ctrl/Shift/Cmd+左键用系统默认程序打开，Alt+左键复制绝对路径，右键 8 项菜单（在侧栏打开 / 在浮窗中打开 / 在文件夹中显示 / 用默认程序打开 / 另存为… / 复制文件 / 复制文件路径 / 添加到对话框）。宿主端提供回环只读路由与 /saveas /copyfile 两个文件搬运动作（Shell COM 揭示、WinForms 保存对话框、CF_HDROP 剪贴板），客户端零侵入、不改 React 节点、不接管 markdown 图片语法。解决「产物要打开得先复制路径再粘到文件管理器」的反复割裂。/ Turn declared artifact paths into one-click chips: resident system-prompt rules force absolute paths, the client half renders file names as clickable chips, left click previews in DSH's built-in sidebar (absolute paths resolve in 0 round-trips; unclaimed types fall back to the default app), Ctrl/Shift/Cmd+click opens with the system default app, Alt+click copies the absolute path, and the right-click menu offers eight actions (open in sidebar / open in floating window / reveal in Explorer / open with default app / save-as / copy-file / copy-path / insert-into-composer). Host routes are loopback-only; zero telemetry. Note: 0.5.4-0.5.6 had a broken open-in-floater action; 0.5.7 fixes it.
侧边栏浏览器搜索引擎以及书签功能补丁插件（dsh-browser-hub）：给 DSH 自带「浏览器」Tab 增加搜索引擎选择、书签收藏、多级文件夹与导入 360/Chrome 书签 HTML。

对话里的图值得被认真看：点一下全屏灯箱（缩放/拖拽平移/下载另存/左右翻页），一键把会话内的图收成可调列数的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏（不留空白）；本地图 TIFF/HEIC 自动无损转码，网图被防盗链拦截时自动转存本地显示；并内置「图片投递铁律」——强制图片写进回复正文而不是只躺在折叠的工具行里，避免用户误以为没发图。| Chat images get a proper look: full-screen lightbox (zoom / drag pan / download / prev-next), a conversation-wide thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, hide/show without leaving blank space, lossless TIFF/HEIC transcoding, and automatic local fallback for hotlink-protected images — plus a resident delivery rule that forces every image into the reply body instead of a collapsed tool row, so nobody ever wonders whether an image was actually sent.

DSH console sentinel for Windows — one-click cleanup of taskbar windows and empty console shells, plus per-window provenance (parent chain / full command line / script path / start time) so you can see what spawned each console and decide whether to block it. Each row also carries a red parent chip (父：name(pid), or 父：已退出 for orphans whose parent already exited), and a one-click orphan cleanup closes console windows whose parent has exited but which kept running — safe mode never touches mpiexec/fluent/ansys/node compute processes. Graceful WM_CLOSE (= Alt+F4) per window or whole app, UAC-elevated close for admin apps, icon-grid and detail views, preview-before-execute, persistent whitelist, and hard protection for the DSH host and Fluent/MPI solvers. Note: 1.3.4 stops the auto-hide log flood of 1.3.2 and earlier; 1.3.5 fixes a broken console_windows_list tool.

Unofficial DeepSeek Web provider for DeepSeek Harness: use chat.deepseek.com as an LLM source AND embed the DeepSeek web page inside DSH (right sidebar tab or draggable whale floating window) with one-time sign-in shared by the settings page and both panel surfaces. Select conversation text and right-click to copy it straight into the embedded DeepSeek composer. 非官方 DeepSeek 网页端插件：既能把网页端当模型用，也能在 DSH 内嵌网页面板直接对话（侧栏标签页 / 鲸鱼悬浮球），登录一次，设置页与面板共用同一份宿主凭据；选中会话文字右键即可把内容复制到 DeepSeek 网页输入框。仅供个人方便使用，可能存在账号风险，作者不承担责任。
「字」悬浮球 + 字体DIY面板：每区域独立调字体/颜色/字号/粗细/斜体/行高，全局统一、方案管理、8 款可爱字体一键安装、130 款皮肤三球同步。

LobsterAIDaddy — a draggable floating ball for DSH that manages multiple LobsterAI accounts with its own built-in data layer (reads LobsterAI's SQLite directly and calls the official APIs), so no separate desktop console has to be running: the drawer shows the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, then the account list with balances, plan, today's usage, reward details, per-account check-in state and last check-in time, plus four action buttons (check in all, log in a new account without signing out, refresh quota, sync gateway into DSH) and one-click account switching. Also ships a scheduled auto check-in, an account-count badge refreshed every 30s, a resizable persisted drawer, a self-hosted board page, and a follow toggle that keeps the panel with the ball. 把 LobsterAI 多账号管理变成 DSH 界面悬浮球的插件：签到、额度、切号、当前账号显示全部由插件内置实现（直读 SQLite + 直调官方接口），不依赖 LobsterDaddy 控制台常驻；可拖拽摆位并自动记忆，面板可跟随悬浮球移动；点开即显示当前登录账号与账号列表（余额、套餐、今日已用、奖励明细、已签到状态与最近签到时间），顶部四个操作按钮（立即全部签到 / ＋免退出登录新账号 / 刷新额度 / 同步网关到 DSH）加每行切号；内置定时自动签到调度器，悬浮球账号数徽标每 30 秒自动更新，并自带本地看板页。

三级级联模型面板：来源 / 模型 / 强度三列并排，识图与思考强度一键开关，内置「启用智能体团队协作」开关，逐模型真实测活并持久化结果。| A three-column cascade model picker for DSH: provider → model → reasoning effort, one-click image/reasoning switches, a built-in teammate toggle, real per-model availability probes with persisted results.

侧边栏日程中心（dsh-better-sidebar companion）：今日一屏（多城市天气按 8:30/12:00/17:30 定点刷新 + 黄历 + 可折叠星座运势）、农历月历、日程与待办、日报周报与签到、按人设置班制与上下班倒计时；多账号邮件客户端（IMAP 收信 + SMTP 发信，附件收发、群发、草稿箱、收藏/垃圾/垃圾箱/已读未读）；久坐 / 喝水 / 护眼 / 听音乐提醒弹面板内胶囊（停留秒数与位置可调）并可同时推 Windows 通知；壁纸轮播（顺序或随机洗牌、透明度与磨砂）与界面文字颜色可调。数据只存本机。

技能浏览器：悬浮球打开面板，把本机技能库变成可浏览、可检索、可治理的资产——五个 Tab（技能浏览/调用台账/MCP 管理/市场/快速上手）、树状/平铺双视图、手动+关键词+AI 三种分组（分组只改视图不动技能文件）、调用台账看板（调用次数/成功率/趋势图/技能调用排行）、130 款三球同步皮肤（6 列宽屏菜单）、9 步快速上手、MCP 管理（读取运行时 MCP 配置、真实连接状态、工具清单与自动功能概括、调用统计落盘、启停即时跟随/重连/卸载/导出标准 mcpServers JSON、重绘不跳顶且面板记忆上次滚动位置、卡片每行列数技能 3~6 / MCP 3~5）、DSH 设置页悬浮球导航分区（「作者插件/插件版本」两块切换 + 15 行插件版本一键检查全部）；一键热重载，技能库位置可配置，悬浮球可拖拽可复位、市场（MCP 市场：官方 Registry + 29 条精选免费目录、19 大类平铺分类带每类数量、网格/列表双模式、卡片逐字复刻技能卡、每条 MCP 用其自身真实图标并自动降级、一键安装写入 cordis.patch.yml 并自动备份、一键卸载、仅免费筛选、24 小时磁盘缓存、与 MCP 页双向即时同步）。

DSH todo 悬浮球：常驻可拖动悬浮球实时显示当前会话 todo_write 任务清单进度（完成数/总数/进行中任务名），带百分比进度环；Shadow DOM 样式隔离，点击折叠/展开完整清单，右键胶囊模式；状态颜色（待办蓝/进行中橙脉动/完成绿）。数据双路同步：权威会话投影帧为主 + MutationObserver 抓官方 todo 面板为辅，旧计划自动归档为历史不会被误算进进度。可固定多会话并排查看，130 款共享皮肤（8 组：官方主题 / 浓郁深底 / 尘埃灰调 / 招牌特效 / 浅色纸面 / 柔光深底 / 中性点缀 / 克制精选 + 随系统深浅自动）。宿主端每轮注入 todo 纪律并硬性要求首个工具调用为 todo_write。双端可用（Desktop 桌面端 + Web 网页端）。零遥测，仅一条本机回环健康路由。

让 DSH 干完活会开口说话：回合结束自动播报「完成 / 失败」，零配置内置 20 个音效（无需 API Key），也可使用在火山引擎「声音复刻」克隆好的音色 ID（插件不提供录音与训练，只负责播放）。另有第三个「审批」音效槽位，但只能手动触发（/dsh-voice-alert/play?kind=approval），不会自动播报。| Make DSH speak when the job is done: automatic voice/sound alerts for done and failed turns, 20 built-in sounds with zero config, or a voice ID you cloned on Volcengine Voice Cloning (this plugin does not record or train — it only plays). A third approval slot exists but is manual-only (/dsh-voice-alert/play?kind=approval) — nothing fires it automatically.
A draggable to-do note on every session: short-term tasks, long-term plan progress, and a live prompt snapshot so the agent stops re-reading context.

Layered, auto-injected cross-session memory for AI coding agents: a DSH plugin plus a standalone zero-dependency CLI. Borrows the spec/change/archive discipline from OpenSpec (MIT), but pushes instead of pulls.
Context-aware composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness, with draft completion, prompt polishing, per-session suggestions and stale-response protection.

webCandidates.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件「公众号成稿台」：写稿、按段改稿、朱雀报告质检、公众号排版预览和一键复制。
VisionForge: vision understanding + image generation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
Live2D 看板娘插件 for DeepSeek Harness — 可拖动的 Live2D 模型，支持 DSH 状态驱动动画、本地模型导入和完整配置页。

DSH web plugin: a hierarchical workspace tree for the sidebar with browser-style session tabs, time-bucket sorting and session pinning. Workspace titles containing "/" group into virtual folders (web/前端 · web/后端); sessions open in replaceable tabs (Shift+click for a new one, drag to reorder), sort by recency buckets (today/yesterday/7d/30d/earlier) or pin to the top of the sidebar.
Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: after a turn settles, the empty composer shows a dimmed suggestion of your next message; Tab accepts it.
dsh bundle plugin: grok2api image & video generation tools plus image recognition (generate_image / generate_video / recognize_image) for the DeepSeek Harness

Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation, order/random playlists and a fullscreen wallpaper.
Windows desktop notifications, sounds, and DSH-styled in-app notification cards for DeepSeek Harness
DSH-styled three-column workspace with file editing, Markdown preview, Git controls, terminals, and native conversation
DSH plugin: 「进度」实验/项目进度管理 — agent 工具（progress_*）+ better-sidebar 侧边栏界面（iframe 托管原版界面），数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json。可通过 github: 或 npm 安装到任意 DSH 桌面 profile。
把本机思源字体的用途表钉进系统提示词（正文 思源黑体 CN Medium、标题 思源宋体 CN Heavy、西文 思源黑体、加粗 思源黑体 CN Bold），禁止模型再检测、比较、提问字体；设置页提供可视化面板，按用途 × 中文/西文自定义任意本机字体。
本地已装插件总览：不下载插件，和插件市场搭配；一键收纳第三方插件设置，AI 整理备注与分组，配合健康诊断和启停，让插件不再乱而不知。
任务结束后自动关机 —— 侧边栏守夜卡片：五道判定闸、后台任务守卫、AFK 接管、阻断态分级
Cross-session and cross-project memory manager for dsh (silent turn-end sedimentation + native web client embedding)
把 DSH 会话事件（中断 / 结束 / 报错 / 等待操作）聚合到一个 IM 通道，推到 QQ / 飞书，带可点按钮与定向回复

Low-token web search for dsh: compact, sanitized {title, url, snippet} results with a pluggable, auto-failing-over backend chain (Tavily / Exa / SearXNG / Brave / Google CSE) and a token budget you control

Codex-style Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: Windows desktop control, screenshots, UI Automation, human input handoff, approval gates and prebuilt native workers. Install and update from dsh-market without PowerShell 7 or build steps.
一池多宠的 DSH 桌宠：每个活跃会话各一只，工作状态指示、模型/供应商配色与 tok/s 跑速、会话右键「专属宠物保持」、子代理跟随与共享养成。
跨目录 / 跨项目的 DSH 会话内置通话：任意两条会话直接收发消息、工具级唤醒、只读查看与用量 · Cross-directory session calling for DSH.
MarkPilot CM6 3.6.17 Markdown editor for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with version-guarded atomic saves and durable draft recovery.
Read-only side questions for DeepSeek Harness — ask in the margin, keep the main thread clean.
Give DeepSeek Harness Auto review its own reviewer model instead of following the main model.
Web attention badge: a top-left corner indicator counting sessions waiting for user input or finished-but-unopened, plus a browser tab title prefix
Cloudflare Access JWT verification and remote DSH privileged authorization
DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件，对话中粘贴链接，Agent 即可读写节点/图层/变量/样式，生成 React/Vue 代码，OAuth 安全登录，Token 本机存储，内置工作流指令和 Skill 引导使用
A tiny person in a blue-whale onesie you can drag around the DSH window; he sticks to the window edges, pressed flat, and blinks now and then.

DSH web plugin: artifacts for the web GUI: sidebar tab with versions/diff/pick-and-ask, Markdown-to-page server, two-way chat bridge, local library shelf, media and file artifacts with viewers and direct downloads, media generation, an agent CLI, a template library and agent tools (artifact templates, artifact_list, artifact_add, artifact_remove).

Keep long DeepSeek Harness chats cheap and under control: /new gives a chat a fresh context in place from a model-written handoff, /rewind takes the chat and the files the agent edited back to any prompt, plus an automatic compaction level, recovery after failed turns, /drop, pins, message versions, silent messages between chats and multi-chat orchestration, in one sidebar tab.

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: nudge opted-in chats when they go idle (quiet hours, backoff, goal-aware, error-only mode, preview), plus a secret-protected HTTP API to prompt any chat from scripts, cron or webhooks.

Mail for agents and humans in the DeepSeek Harness: IMAP, POP3 and SMTP accounts, Gmail with an app password, Tzekos Mail, Lettermint, Resend and AgentMail; a local cache, a Mail sidebar tab with a reading view, an accounts editor in DSH Settings, and mail_* agent tools with draft-first sending.

Note Keeper for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: an Obsidian-compatible notes app in the left sidebar - Markdown notes, audio transcription (Greek/English), a retro paint canvas with OCR, attachments, client-side zero-knowledge encryption, tags, full-text search, backlinks and graph - with notes_* tools so models can read and write notes. Go backend.

Agent swarm and task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: an Orchestrate sidebar tab and orch_* tools to spawn, prompt and fork agent chats, run command, scrape, http and agent tasks on local, ssh or remote runners, provider status cards, and a secret-protected machine API.

Phone for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: SMS and calls in a sidebar tab (Twilio, SIP lines through an Asterisk relay), call audio through your server, live voicemail with transcripts, a Telegram account with chats, voice messages and calls, and phone_* and telegram_* agent tools.

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a notify-only update checker for the plugins in your profile. Classifies every dependency by its specifier (registry, github, release tarball, link), checks only registry.npmjs.org and api.github.com, applies the DSH compatibility gate against the running core, and never installs anything.

Read-aloud, dictation and language-aware speech for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: many TTS/STT providers at once (EU vendors first: Mistral, Speechmatics, Gladia, ReadSpeaker; plus ElevenLabs, Azure, Google, Amazon, OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible servers, Deepgram, Cartesia, AssemblyAI, Fish, self-hosted Piper/XTTS/Kokoro, the browser voice), per-language routing, in-text language markers and word highlighting.
Workspace-first sidebar rail for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: pinned chats and folders, projects with their own folder and instructions, virtualized Recents, transcript search and unread markers.

Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom proxy with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, agent-visible status and a bypass-aware prompt section
给每个 DSH 对话设置项目状态标签（进行中/已结项/搁置中 + 自定义），会话列表最小可见，对话内头部角落可切换，跨会话/跨浏览器持久化
BTW side-ask panel for the DSH web GUI: answer from the current conversation (per-message anchors) in independent, history-preserving side sessions without writing to the main conversation.

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI plugin: pin sidebar sessions to the top (within the session group or globally across the workspace) and give each session a tab color plus an emoji shown before its name. Dual-face (host + browser), persisted by the host, no DSH source changes.
AI 合同式任务看板 —— DeepSeek Harness Web 插件：AI 拆解、AI 实现、AI 举证，人来验收。
把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动，纯函数计分。
Bring WorkBuddy, Qoder and Trae subscription models into DeepSeek Harness with multi-account failover, per-account proxies and model controls. · 将 WorkBuddy、Qoder、Trae 的订阅模型接入 DSH。
Trace explorer for dsh-superagent: one task, from first event to last reply.
Personal WeChat (iLink ClawBot) as a dsh-superagent Source: DM your bot, it decides whether the message is work, and the result comes back in the same chat.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows — configuration form on the Plugins page, media upload cache, concurrency gate, background tasks. · DSH 插件：在对话里运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流。

Opt-in adaptation packs for the DSH mobile surface (a host-aware 44px touch floor, icon-button width, width reclaim, floating-widget clearance) plus a compatibility list of third-party plugins on a phone.

Cross-session todo list for DeepSeek Harness where an agent"s "done" never settles itself — the record waits in Needs review until a person confirms it. Built for a phone: the panel measures its own width, folds on scroll and keeps 44px touch targets. One JSON file both sides write, numbered step hand-offs, session read-back, and two machines folding one list through a shared directory.
Token usage statistics and chart visualization for DeepSeek Harness: per-session drawer, today / last 3 / last 7 days panel, and chart configuration.
GitHub Copilot credential provider for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth device-flow sign-in for its built-in github-copilot route
Export, merge-restore, and privately sync this profile's selected plugins and configuration.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: control Desktop sessions from WeCom, with session cards, attachments, approvals and task results.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a modular dashboard with 52 built-in widgets, plus widgets your agent builds for you.
ShellPulse AI news in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: hot ranking, timeline and featured picks with Chinese titles and summaries.
Session Tree: a per-workspace map of DeepSeek Harness sessions, turns and fork branches in the Web UI

File-defined DSH command hooks with approval-only UI, read-only details, lifecycle and tool gates

No MCP protocol code: connection and tool registration are 100% the official client, resolved from the running DSH profile.
Schedule a detached DSH restart from inside DSH via /dsh-restart command or dsh_restart agent tool

Agent-decided approvals for DeepSeek Harness: an 自动审批 permission mode where every sandbox escalation is judged automatically by an LLM (default judge: one direct LLM call with no subagent session; optional isolated judge subagent) plus an independent 自动审查 per-call review mode (Full access base; the machine-changing calls bash/pwsh/write/edit/str_replace_editor and MCP tools mcp__* are reviewed before execution by the TypeSafe Jev decision model — read-only tools are not reviewed — with interpreter scripts the command references expanded into the judge state so temp scripts are judged by their actual code; risky calls rejected with no human fallback), with a configurable judge model and a per-session audit trail in the conversation window's 审批 tab.
Archive manager for DeepSeek Harness: DSH < 0.1.7 gets the grouped search/restore/delete panel; DSH >= 0.1.7 adds the delete action missing from the built-in archive management.
WhaleHarbor web onboarding: lite-client standalone window (--app), background installer download with mirror fallback + SHA-256 verify, browser task notifications, and a full-version install prompt.

DSH 正式 bundle 插件：在官方右侧边栏（sidebarRightTabs）注册「HiLog 检查器」与「ArkUI Inspector」两个独立页面 Tab（HiLog 实时流 + 过滤；ArkUI UI 树 dump / 截图 / tap / swipe / text），并提供 .ets 文件查看器（ArkTS 语法高亮，内容经官方 remote.workspaceFiles 分页读取）；为对话 agent 提供 harmony_project 工程模型（JSON5 配置 / 模块 / Ability / 权限 / 产物）、ArkWeb Web DOM 只读工具 harmony_web_dom（Chromium CDP DOM 读取 + outerHTML）与 ArkTS 运行时调试器 harmony_debug（Hvigor Source Map 驱动的 .ets 源码断点与源码调用栈，兼保留编译 URL 断点；attach / 暂停 / 单步 / 求值，与 DevEco Studio 同款调试通道；应用停在断点时自动把暂停位置与调用栈通知回会话，无需轮询；日志与应用管理直接用官方 devecocli log / devecocli device app，不重复造轮子）；路径配置为设置根区的「HarmonyOS Suite」页面（settings.section；DevEco Studio / HarmonyOS Command Line Tools，含三平台自发现、两者互斥、CLT 最低 26.0.0 校验；若 PATH 存在 devecocli 则优先使用，忽略配置路径；未安装 devecocli 时设备列表 / 日志 / 截图 / Tap/Swipe/Text / 窗口列表自动降级到 SDK 自带的 hdc）。

DSH 正式 bundle 插件：在 DSH Web UI 里管理 Git 工作区——入口在输入框「模式」选择器旁（仅 git 仓库显示），进入与设置同规格的居中面板：变更暂存（hunk 级/行级/stash）、分支与 tag、交互式 rebase、提交历史（分支线图形/过滤/范围对比/revert/reset/fixup/undo）、合并冲突解决、blame/reflog、worktree 管理（行内脏状态、作用域切进 review 改动、自动注册为 DSH 工作区）、remote/config 设置，以及**子仓库支持**（git submodule + 嵌套独立仓库：仓库树发现、变更聚合分组、仓库切换、指针 diff 与冲突解决、submodule 管理与嵌套仓库注册）。

Persistent project memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from ZCode: ZCode-style markdown memory store (per project + global) with a full memory-management page in Settings, index-first prompt injection with provenance, an agent memory lifecycle (memory_save / memory_get / memory_list / memory_forget / memory_correct / memory_review), a restorable recycle bin, supersede chains, and one-click import from an existing ZCode memory directory.
为 DeepSeek Harness 中本地已配置的模型追加系统提示词：按 provider/model 精确匹配或服务商级通配（provider/*）注入到系统提示词末尾，设置面板逐模型管理，规则持久化、重启不丢。

Remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pairs a HarmonyOS phone app with the desktop Host over an end-to-end-encrypted public relay (WebSocket). Lets the phone list/create/switch sessions, send prompts, watch streamed replies, cancel turns, and answer approval and ask-user-question requests from anywhere; pushes Huawei Push Kit notifications (gracefully disabled when AGC is unconfigured) for approvals, questions, and turn completion. The pairing QR lives in the DSH settings panel ("DSH Pocket"). Fail-open by design: any relay timeout or fault hands the request back to the desktop answerer.

Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness (7/30-day per-model charts + yearly heatmap) plus an inline coding-plan balance/quota readout in the composer (minimax/deepseek/kimi/openrouter/zhipu/mimo/opencode-go/bailian; mimo uses the dashboard cookie since MiMo exposes no API-key quota API; bailian Token Plan uses AK/SK -> CLI access token -> console gateway, configurable in the settings page when a qwen token plan model is set up).

Offline diagnostic for DeepSeek Harness — 28 built-in + 5 catalog checks across env/profile/session (Layer A checks-as-data), self-update (Layer B), and a semi-automatic LLM observer (Layer C, --observe); Doctor panel in web UI settings.
Sidebar-foot Reload UI and Restart App buttons: reload refreshes the interface and client plugins only, restart relaunches the DeepSeek Harness desktop app together with its Host.

Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens — each works on its own and more arrive as the shell grows: an eight-theme minimalist gallery, sidebar panel folding, and reload/restart buttons at the sidebar foot. · 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加：8 套极简主题画廊、侧栏面板收纳，以及侧栏底部的刷新界面与重启应用按钮。

DSH plugin: hand the agent a GitNexus code graph (impact, context and query as model tools), anchor the index to the commit it describes after every refresh, and put GitNexus's own web UI (resizable 3D view, AI settings pre-filled from the environment) beside a sidebar panel for coverage, refresh gating, symbol and full-text search, file history and maintenance.

OpenRouter Provider List — 从官方目录勾选 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商，或按模型规则分别限定，并设置量化位数限制与服务层级（service_tier），作为 provider.only / provider.order / provider.quantizations 与顶层 service_tier 注入；支持图片输入（按宿主的图片预算契约透传）；路由按 baseURL 主机识别，provider 可任意重命名；可选地把请求改经 billion-context 压缩代理。配置由插件自持（$DSH_HOME/openrouter-providers.json），不依赖 settings 命名空间注册，因此同时适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1。配置入口：DSH >= 0.1.6-alpha.2 在侧栏「插件」页的组合包页面，更早宿主在「设置 → 插件 → 插件配置」。
dsh-pocket 的 fork：把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋——一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。

Remote Windows administration for the dsh web GUI: WinRM/PowerShell Remoting host config store (~/.dsh/dsh-winrm.json), PowerShell exec / streaming console / service & process management / remote text read-write-edit / streamed file transfer / cluster execution, plus agent tools (winrm_list, winrm_exec, winrm_service, winrm_process, winrm_read, winrm_write, winrm_edit, winrm_upload, winrm_download, winrm_cluster). Runs entirely on a native Node.js WinRM client (winrm-client) — no Python/pywinrm required. Standalone Cordis plugin — mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules link, no dsh source changes.
Nico glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web UI — glass material rendered by nico-glass-kit. Adapted for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
A generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement; tuck it away with a header button at any time.
Independent local RSS Pal reader and AI companion for DSH
GitHub 趋势日报的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：按日 / 周 / 月周期定时 spawn 本地 trendradar 核心，抓取 Trending、生成中文简介与周期总结，并可选把订阅仓库的新 Release 合成中文摘要，一起提交到你的仓库、自动开 PR 合并；内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。
统一管理本地技能的安装、更新、删除与接入，让同一份技能在多个 Agent 间复用。A skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: install, update, remove, link and toggle agent skills.

LAN/internet reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: binds 0.0.0.0 and forwards to the loopback dsh web server. Default-deny: every source (loopback, LAN, internet) must sign in with an HMAC session cookie unless lanPasswordless is explicitly enabled; against a session-capable dsh base (0.2.0 and 0.2.1) the gateway relays one shared upstream browser session, so the harness's own authorization still gates every request. Fail-closed start guard (password required, plaintext needs an explicit opt-in), session revocation by epoch (password changes and secret rotation kill cookies and live WebSockets), same-site/Origin fence on HTTP and WebSocket upgrades, optional TLS (auto self-signed or user-supplied certs), and a configuration page on the dsh Plugins page (the bundle's own `plugins.bundle.config` slot) for live adjustment of port, CIDRs, auth, TLS, and the login password (the card overwrites the stored credential without ever displaying the old one; the password stays a scrypt hash in state.json, out of the config schema). The order is the feature — an npm publish is irreversible and a draft is not, so a refused npm push leaves the Release unpublished and the pipeline can be resumed, or the Release published without npm. The separate buttons remain for a repository whose release must stay a draft. It also carries the third channel: when a release goes public, one short update note is posted under the video that introduces the plugin, with the credential obtained from a Bilibili sign-in inside the panel. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI and the Host's own package manager, so the plugin stores no GitHub or npm credential of its own; the one credential it does own is the Bilibili session it created, kept in its own directory and never echoed back.

Sidebar restart button for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: one click fully quits and reopens the app.

A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
A calm, unified prompt queue for DeepSeek Harness with smart expansion, persistent confirmations, editing, steering, accessible reordering, and official queue removal.
在 Web GUI 里可视化管理 agent team 的角色：每个角色是一份独立 preset，开关它自己的能力行（工具 / 技能 / MCP / 分组 / loop / AGENTS.md），只引用现有行、不新增行、不改任何现有文件。

Host half runs the full OpenAI OAuth flow (PKCE S256, localhost:1455 callback) and writes the llm-pi-ai/openai-codex grant record through ctx.credentials.

Input history switcher for the DSH composer: locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachment bytes, max 50, newest-first) and re-fills the empty composer via ArrowUp/ArrowDown with file references and image previews re-attached through the conversation draft pipeline.

Every DSH session is an independent AI with no awareness of the others; any session can host, set a topic and goal, invite the rest in order, and they speak one at a time until the rounds run out or the goal is met, then the meeting closes with written minutes. It doubles as a multi-agent game engine with targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks and elimination. Includes a beginner guide. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer and the guide were built by 插件·3代小星辰.

Local-first DeepSeek Harness control center for balance monitoring, usage accounting, time-aware custom third-party API pricing, a 365-day local token ledger, Z.ai Coding Plan quotas, official pricing sync, encrypted multi-account switching, reminders, recharge, and host-gated session controls.

Pixel-art office for DeepSeek Harness: one fixed-pixel tower where every workspace is a floor and every session is an office, with lit windows, scrolling floors and click-through into any session.

Provides HMCL/PCL-launcher-style modpack packaging and installation for DeepSeek Harness: bundle several plugins with their configuration and data into one .dshpack and install it in a single pass. Two forms: a self-contained full pack that a machine with only DSH installed can install, and a lite pack that records names and versions and fetches them on install. Each plugin can be packed from its upstream release with default configuration or from a local copy (code, config entries, data snapshot); configuration is re-applied by entry, data is restored under ~/.dsh without overwriting existing files, and suspected credentials become ${REDACTED}. Categories, search, paging and entries come from the plugin-market catalog, and market versions are preferred when online. Packing always runs an in-memory scan for secrets and risky code (masked, never written to disk); high-risk hits pause the job until confirmed, then it resumes from the checkpoint without rescanning. Installation re-checks sha256 integrity, compatibility and licences, and can finish without enabling or enable right away. The UI can live in settings, the sidebar or the plugins tab, each switchable. Installing the plugin market (dshmarket) first is recommended, not required.

dsh 插件 · 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

dsh 插件 · WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证或复用 user-management 账号、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

dsh 插件 · 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动复盘，把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，模型可直接调用；同时把环境事实与用户偏好写入跨会话记忆（MEMORY.md / USER.md，首冻结注入每个对话）；支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

Free Bing-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). No API key needed, uses cn.bing.com for mainland China accessibility.
Handoff button for DeepSeek Harness: adds a button to every assistant message that writes a whole-session handoff document into the workspace /handoff directory.
DSH 生图插件：在设置中配置多个生图供应商/模型，并在对话中通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型。
DSH MCP 服务器管理插件：在设置中提供 MCP Servers 管理面板，负责把服务器配置写入当前 Profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 并启停官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 条目；连接、重连、工具注册与 teardown 由官方 client 负责。

Extension for DeepSeek Harness's official terminal: renders it in an in-app bottom panel, redirects Desktop "open terminal" entry points into that panel, and exposes the dsh CLI inside terminals. No second PTY/xterm stack.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a composer-bar cost pill with this turn's and this session's estimated spend, a two-column breakdown dialog, and a hot-reloadable peak/off-peak price table.
DSH(DeepSeek Harness)主题分组侧栏插件:叠加注入原生侧边栏工作区区域,提供工作区下拉筛选、主题文件夹树、批量归档/取消归档与安全永久删除。

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar companion): code and config file preview with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline navigation (class / method / variable, JSON/YAML/TOML/XML keys), whole-file search, chunked/paged large-file preview, and selection -> clickable quote chip in the conversation.
Review agent-produced file changes (line-level red/green diff + undo) both as a chat turn-tail row and as a dsh-better-sidebar tab; a port of left0ver's dsh-file-review.
Recent sessions across every workspace in one panel — plus a place to jot a thought now and have it come back when you reopen that conversation.
DSH Web UI 插件应用商店：目录浏览/搜索/一键安装/兼容徽章/已装列表。A plugin store for DSH Web UI — catalog browse, search, one-click install, compat badges, installed list.
DSH plugin: a shared task board for multi-agent / subagent collaboration — create, claim, transition, and query tasks via a Cordis service key.
A global hotkey that opens a small prompt bar from anywhere on your Mac and starts a DeepSeek Harness session with what you type.

DeepSeek Harness plugin: memory graphs for every chat, on by default (switch the plugin off on the Plugins page to stop); other chats in the workspace recall exact past text by topic, chat or day, so fewer input tokens are re-sent
Multiple chat panels for DeepSeek Harness: view and interact with several agent sessions side by side in a Mission Control grid
Enhanced workspace directory browser for the dsh web UI: quick access to /mnt Windows drives, full breadcrumb ancestry from the filesystem root, and an always-visible path input.
Use your ChatGPT plan in DeepSeek Harness with independent Sign in with ChatGPT authorization
